title: Casimir phenomena in bumblebee gravity
summary: In this work, we analyze the Casimir effect associated with a massive, non-minimally coupled scalar field in static, spherically symmetric black hole spacetimes arising in bumblebee gravity. Three distinct solutions are considered, corresponding to different vacuum expectation value configurations of the Lorentz-violating vector field, including metric and \textit{metric-affine} scenarios.
